newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable in slow range trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable in slow range trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in slow range trading on Monday morning, with swaps remaining biddish, dealers said.
They said trading was fairly thin, with rates seen stuck at between 2,600 and 2,615 against the dollar.
"It's a dull morning. The rupiah was given and taken around the 2,610 level since opening," one U.S. bank dealer said.
She said some operators were reluctant to sell dollars on fear of further turbulence in the region while buyers stood back at the high level and on possible central bank action.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,605/10 at 0245 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,605/15. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,604.5/09.5 and 2,604/09, respectively.
Dealers said operators were also seen increasingly cautious of buying dollars as the central bank was tightening money market liquidity gradually.
Overnight money was traded at around 16.0/17.0 percent as the bank kept overnight bilateral SBIs rates at 14.0 percent.
Dealers said many operators could proceed with arbitrage deals from the swap market as overnight swap was traded at 0.2/0.3 and tom/next at 0.25/0.35 points.
They said the gradual tightening kept the underlying tone in the swap market biddish.
One-month swap was at 21.0/23.0, two at 42.0/48.0, three at 63.0/73.0 and six at 125.0/135.0 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,378/2,682 but raised the conversion band to 2,592/2,640 on Friday from 2,566/2,614 on Thursday.
